definitions.explanation: Within a specified group or set.
Within a time period; before something changes.
Refers to one's own home, family, or organization.

examples.japanese: {三人|さんにん}の{内|うち}、{一人|ひとり}が{女性|じょせい}だ。
examples.english: Of the three, one is a woman.

examples.japanese: {若|わか}い{内|うち}に{旅行|りょこう}したい。
examples.english: I want to travel while I'm young.

examples.japanese: {内|うち}の{会社|かいしゃ}では...
examples.english: At our company...

examples.japanese: {知|し}らない{内|うち}に{寝|ね}ていた。
examples.english: I fell asleep without realizing it.

examples.japanese: {暗|くら}くならない{内|うち}に{帰|かえ}ろう。
examples.english: Let's go home before it gets dark.

examples.japanese: {内|うち}と{外|そと}の{温度|おんど}が{違|ちが}います。
examples.english: The temperature inside and outside is different.

examples.japanese: {五人|ごにん}の{内|うち}、{二人|ふたり}が{来|こ}られませんでした。
examples.english: Of the five, two couldn't come.

examples.japanese: {内|うち}の{子供|こども}は{今年|ことし}{小学校|しょうがっこう}に{入|はい}ります。
examples.english: Our child will start elementary school this year.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{心|こころ}の{内|うち}を{見|み}せない。
examples.english: He doesn't show his inner feelings.

examples.japanese: {忘|わす}れない{内|うち}に{書|か}いておきます。
examples.english: I'll write it down before I forget.

examples.japanese: {候補|こうほ}の{内|うち}から{一|ひと}つを{選|えら}んでください。
examples.english: Please choose one from among the candidates.

examples.japanese: {内|うち}の{犬|いぬ}はとても{元気|げんき}です。
examples.english: Our dog is very energetic.

examples.japanese: {建物|たてもの}の{内|うち}は{涼|すず}しかったです。
examples.english: The inside of the building was cool.

examples.japanese: {今日|きょう}の{内|うち}に{終|お}わらせましょう。
examples.english: Let's finish it within today.

examples.japanese: {十人|じゅうにん}の{内|うち}、{半分|はんぶん}は{女性|じょせい}です。
examples.english: Of the ten people, half are women.

examples.japanese: {内|うち}の{母|はは}は{料理|りょうり}が{上手|じょうず}です。
examples.english: My mother is good at cooking.

examples.japanese: {箱|はこ}の{内|うち}に{何|なに}が{入|はい}っていますか。
examples.english: What's inside the box?

examples.japanese: {雨|あめ}が{降|ふ}らない{内|うち}に{買|か}い{物|もの}に{行|い}きましょう。
examples.english: Let's go shopping before it rains.

examples.japanese: {三|みっ}つの{選択肢|せんたくし}の{内|うち}、どれが{一番|いちばん}いいですか。
examples.english: Of the three options, which is the best?

examples.japanese: {内|うち}では{靴|くつ}を{脱|ぬ}いでください。
examples.english: Please take off your shoes inside (our house).

notes:
{内|うち} has multiple meanings related to 'inside' or 'within.'

Grammar patterns:
- 〜の{内|うち}: among ~, of ~
- 〜{内|うち}に: while ~, before ~ (changes)
- 〜ない{内|うち}に: before ~ happens

In-group usage:
- {内|うち}: my home, our family, our company (humble)
- {内|うち}の + [person/thing]: my/our ~

Contrast:
- {内|うち} (inside, in-group) vs. {外|そと} (outside, out-group)
- {内|うち} can be humble; {お宅|おたく} is the polite equivalent for others' homes

Note: The sense of 'inside' is abstract - for physical interiors, {中|なか} is more common.
